content: Abhaana na abhiibhuri
Imwɨ abhaana, kʉ kʉbha mugwatɨɨnɨ nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, mʉsʉʉkɨ abhiibhuri bhaanyu, ko kokorabhu ni ingʼana izʉmu.
“Ʉsʉʉkɨ wuusʉ na onyoko,” rɨnʉ neryo riswaja ryʉ ʉbhʉtangɨ bhwʉ ʉbhʉragɨ,
“korereke obhone omorembe nu ubhwikari sikʉ nzaru kʉʉsɨ.”
Na niimwɨ bha bhaabha, moteendeerya abhaana bhaanyu, nawe mʉbharere bhwaheene na kʉbhaha amiija kurwa kʉMʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu.
Bhambʉʉsa na abhakʉrʉ bhaabhʉ
Imwɨ bhambʉʉsa, mʉsʉʉkɨ abhakʉrʉ bhaanyu mucharʉ hanʉ, kubhusuuku na kurigita kwa mwʉyʉ gʉmwɨ, chɨmbu mʉkʉsʉʉka Kiriisitʉ.
Mokorebhu, ɨtarɨ hanʉ bhakʉbharora korereke mwikombe kwabhʉ, nawe mokore chɨmbu Mungu akwenda kwa mwʉyʉ mwɨrʉ, kʉ kʉbha imwɨ, nɨ‑bhahocha bha Kiriisitʉ.
Mohoche kwa mwʉyʉ gʉmwɨ chɨmbu kohokerya Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, na ɨtarɨ mʉrahokerya abhaatʉ.
Mwikarɨ mwɨzɨ kʉbha, ringʼana rizʉmu ryʉryʉsi rɨnʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ akokora, arahaabhwa nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ kʉrɨngʼaana na amahocha gaazɨ, abhɨ nɨ‑mbʉʉsa hamwɨ ni‑mwiyagaaruri.
Na niimwɨ abhakʉrʉ, mʉbhakorere abhahocha bhaanyu gayogayo, mʉtabhʉʉbhahya. Muhiitɨ kʉbha imwɨ na abhahocha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ waanyu nɨ‑wʉmwɨ arɨ kwisaarʉ, na ataana kɨmbʉrʉʉri.
Ebheseme bhya Mungu
Ɨtɨnɨrʉ mongʼehe kokongʼera kʉMʉkʉrʉ na kʉbhʉnaja bhwa zinguru zaazɨ.
Mwibhohe ebheseme bhya Mungu bhyʉsi korereke mʉtʉrɨ kwanga ɨsɨɨmi ɨmbɨ ya Shɨtaani.
Nɨrabhugabhu kʉ kʉbha, riihɨ ryɨtʉ rɨtarɨ igʉrʉ wa abhaatʉ abheene, ni igʉrʉ wa abhatɨmi, igʉrʉ wa abhakʉrʉ bhi ikiirimya kɨnʉ, igʉrʉ wa abhasirikarɨ bha amasambwa kowereero yɨnʉ ɨtakororekana.
Kwɨbhu mogege ebheseme bhyʉsi bhya Mungu, korereke urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ rʉraahikɨ mʉtʉrɨ kwitana na abhabhisa, na mʉraamarɨ kwitana kuhika ɨtɨnɨrʉ, mwimɨɨrɨrɨ bhwɨma.
Mmbe mwimɨɨrɨrɨ, amaheene gabhɨ ncho omokena mubhwena, ne eheene ɨbhɨ ncha amiibhoho gu ukwiribha mukikubha,
nu ubhwɨndi bhwʉ ʉkʉraganʼya Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yo omorembe ɨbhɨ nchi ibhikwɨra kobherenge bhyanyu.
Kʉkɨra gayo gʉʉsi, ubhwisirirya bhʉbhɨ sikʉ zʉʉsi nchi ingubha mʉmabhoko gaanyu, bhʉbhasakiryɨ kurimya imibhyɨ jo omorero gwa Shɨtaani.
Mʉsʉngʼaanɨ ʉbhʉsabhuri nchɨ ɨngʉhiira yanyu yi ichʉma, nɨ ɨngʼana ya Mungu nchɨ ɨpanga yɨnʉ mʉkʉhaabhwa ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu.
Mʉsabhɨ Mungu sikʉ zʉʉsi, kwa teemwa zʉʉsi za amasabhi. Mʉsabhɨ ibhaga ryʉsi kwa zinguru ze Ekoro ya Mungu. Mʉbhɨ mʉratengeeza ɨnʉ mʉrasabha igʉrʉ wa abharɨndu bhʉʉsi bha Mungu.
Inyʉʉsi mʉnsabhɨrɨ korereke hanʉ nɨkʉgamba, Mungu abhɨ arangʼa chʉ ʉkʉgamba, nɨtʉrɨ kʉbharwazɨra abhaatʉ kwa bhʉkararu amaheene ganʉ Mungu ɨrɨkɨɨnʼyɨ kʉNgʼana Ɨnzʉmu.
Inyɨ nɨhɨɨrwɨ emeremo ju ukurwaza Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yiyo, na yiyo neyo igiriryɨ nɨrɨ mokebhoho, mʉnsabhɨrɨ korereke nebhone ʉbhʉkararu nɨraganʼyɨ chɨmbu nikwenderwa kʉraganʼya.
Ʉrʉbhangʉ
Tikikʉ umwisirirya ʉmʉsɨɨgwa no omohocha ʉmʉkɨndichɨtʉ omoronge wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, arabhaha amangʼana gaanɨ gʉʉsi, momenye kɨnʉ nekokora.
Nimutumirɨ kwa niimwɨ korereke momenye amangʼana gɨɨtʉ na kʉbhaha umwʉyʉ.
Omorembe, ʉbhʉsɨɨgi, hamwɨmwɨ nu ubhwisirirya bhɨbhɨ kubhiisirirya, kurwa kwa Mungu nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhɨbhɨ hamwɨmwɨ na bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhamʉsɨɨgirɨ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, ʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwa sikʉ zʉʉsi.
